current_summary: New schema-2 TRD draft revision 1 is source-reviewed, structurally validated and indexed. Requirements capture awaits exact user approval.
next_step: User approves or requests changes to the presented unchanged TRD revision 1; the host owns its To-TRD approval publication and the manager retains this Task.
open_questions: Does the user approve revision 1 of Integrated Project Curator, ontology and project initialization?
